doc_metadata.notes: Rated criteria response form for HR Advisory service category. Proponents must respond to six evaluation criteria: Corporate Profile, Key Personnel and Roster, Methodology & Advisory Approach, Thought Leadership & Innovation, Relationship Management, and Value-added services. Responses limited to 12 pages excluding resumes and work samples.
doc_metadata.title: APPENDIX D2 - RATED CRITERIA RESPONSE FORM – HR Advisory

evaluation_criteria.notes: Proponents must describe their organisation, its purpose, structure and makeup, including profile and history, number of employees, products and services offered, range and depth of experience, core areas of expertise, and any requirements falling outside firm's scope.

source_refs.excerpt: Proponents are to describe their organisation, its purpose, structure and makeup. Responses should include: Profile and history of the organisation; Number of employees; A list and description of the products and services you offer in support of the objectives and scope described in this service category, the range and depth of your experience with each, and identify which are your core areas of expertise or specialty; A list of any of our requirements that fall outside your firm's scope.
source_refs.source_doc: Amendment1/RFP 2026-026 - Appendix D2 - Rated Criteria Response REVISED.docx

evaluation_criteria.title: Corporate Profile

evaluation_criteria.notes: Proponents must demonstrate capabilities and capacity by describing their team, including internal and external resources. Brief profiles (maximum half a page each) for maximum 4 individuals in dedicated relationship or coordination roles required, including name, proposed role, years of relevant experience, areas of specialization, professional designations, certifications, and credentials. Proponents must also describe practitioner talent available, range of expertise, vetting and development processes, quality and consistency standards, and typical resource assignment process.

source_refs.excerpt: Proponents are to demonstrate their capabilities and capacity to provide the required services by describing their team, including internal and external resources. The response should include: A brief profile (no more than half a page) for each individual (maximum of 4) who would serve in a dedicated relationship or coordination role with the Bank — for example, an account manager, lead consultant, research specialist. These are the people we expect to interact with consistently, independent of any specific engagement. The profile should include: name and proposed role, years of relevant experience, areas of specialization, professional designations, certifications, and credentials. Describe the practitioner talent your firm can draw on, internally or externally. Rather than listing names or submitting bios for all potential resources, tell us about your bench/roster: the range of expertise available, how practitioners are vetted and developed, how you ensure quality and consistency when engaging associates or contractors, and what a typical resource assignment process looks like.
source_refs.source_doc: Amendment1/RFP 2026-026 - Appendix D2 - Rated Criteria Response REVISED.docx

evaluation_criteria.title: Methodology & Advisory Approach

evaluation_criteria.notes: Proponents must demonstrate ability to provide strategic insights, innovative solutions, and leading practices, including examples of innovative solutions or approaches implemented for clients, experience applying research, data analytics, benchmarking, or emerging HR practices to address client challenges, methods used to remain current with HR trends and industry developments, examples of recommendations that resulted in meaningful organizational improvements, and two (2) samples of published articles, white papers, research, frameworks, or thought leadership materials developed by the Proponent (maximum 2 pages per sample).

evaluation_criteria.notes: Proponents must demonstrate experience providing strategic HR advisory services to organizations of similar size, complexity, and operating environment.
